text: 国家税务总局发布的最新发票数据显示，今年前8个月，全国工业销售收入稳步增长，新质生产力加快培育，装备制造业、高技术产业销售收入增长明显。发票数据显示，1—8月份，工业经济稳中有进，工业销售收入同比增长7.3%，其中采矿业、制造业、电力热力燃气及水生产和供应业销售收入同比分别增长8.3%、7.5%和5%，均保持较快增长态势。装备制造业持续发挥“压舱石”作用，销售收入同比增长10.1%，特别是计算机通信设备制造、电气机械器材制造、仪器仪表制造业销售收入同比分别增长18.8%、14%和14.1%。（央视新闻）
text_en: The latest invoice data released by the State Taxation Administration shows that in the first eight months of this year, national industrial sales revenue grew steadily, new quality productive forces were cultivated at a faster pace, and sales revenue in the equipment manufacturing industry and high-tech industries increased significantly. The invoice data show that from January to August, the industrial economy made steady progress, with industrial sales revenue increasing by 7.3% year on year. Among this, sales revenue in mining, manufacturing, and the production and supply of electricity, heat, gas and water increased by 8.3%, 7.5% and 5% year on year respectively, all maintaining relatively rapid growth. The equipment manufacturing industry continued to play the role of a "ballast stone," with sales revenue increasing by 10.1% year on year. In particular, sales revenue in computer and communication equipment manufacturing, electrical machinery and apparatus manufacturing, and instrument and meter manufacturing increased by 18.8%, 14% and 14.1% year on year respectively. (CCTV News)
